_readme: Overlay example: a second profile that inherits everything from kit.config.json and changes only what differs. Build it with: node .claude/skills/msp-ai-kit/scripts/build.mjs --config .claude/skills/msp-ai-kit/profiles/example-client-overlay.json. Objects merge key by key; arrays and scalars replace the base value.

company.clients: one co-managed client: a 40-seat professional-services firm with an internal IT lead

stack.rmm: the client's existing RMM (co-managed console access)
stack.backup: the client's existing backup platform (verified monthly)

team.after_hours: P1 only; the client's internal IT lead is the first call, DE on-call is the second
